device.description: 8-channel 20-bit current-input (charge-integrating) delta-sigma ADC with dual-switched integrators and serial output
device.note: ddc118.pdf (SBAS325B) p.4 specifications (DVDD 2.7-5.25 V, AVDD 4.75-5.25 V, FORMAT 16 / 20 bits, straight binary with an offset), p.5 pin configuration and descriptions (QFN-48), p.13 digital interface (complementary DCLK / DIN / DOUT, DVALID, RESET active low), p.15-16 Table 6 / 7 (t7 cont mode data ready = 1380 CLK periods = 345 us at 4 MHz), p.21 Table 9 code table (0 % FS = 0000 0001 0000 0000 0000), data retrieval, Figure 20 / Table 10 (no chip select: data valid from the DVALID falling edge, Input 8 first, Input 1 last, shifted on DCLK falling edges, t21A 10 ns)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the FORMAT pin level (0 = 16-bit, 1 = 20-bit output words)

pages: p.4 (specifications), p.5 (pinout and pin descriptions), p.13 (digital interface, CLK_4X, HISPD/LOPWR, DVALID, RESET), p.15-16 (Tables 6, 7: data-ready timing), p.21 (FORMAT, Table 9 code table, data retrieval, Figure 20, Table 10), p.22 (daisy chain), p.26 (power-up sequence)
notModeled: charge-integrating analog front end (dual A/B integrators, VREF, RANGE2-RANGE0 full-scale selection, TEST mode, HISPD/LOPWR power mode, CLK_4X clock divider): the output is always the 0 % FS code (Table 9: 0000 0001 0000 0000 0000 with FORMAT = 1, 0000 0001 0000 0000 with FORMAT = 0), written literally in the frame for every input

CONV: in the device every CONV transition (both edges) ends an integration and DVALID goes low t7 = 1380 CLK periods later; the model starts a conversion only on the CONV rising edge (convst edge "rise"), so it reports data every other transition
continuous / non-continuous integration state machine and power-up states: conversion time fixed at t7 = 345 us (+0.125 us) for CLK = 4 MHz, CLK_4X = 0; the CLK pin is not used by the model

complementary signals: the datasheet prints DOUT (pin 2), DIN (pin 35) and DCLK (pin 39) with an overbar and the same names as pins 1, 36 and 40; they are named DOUT-bar, DIN-bar and DCLK-bar here so the bus pins are unambiguous; DOUT-bar is never driven and DIN-bar / DCLK-bar are ignored
DVALID goes high t19 = 5 ns after the first DCLK falling edge; the model clears it when the result is read (bits shifted out)
daisy-chain (Figures 21, 22): after the device's own words DOUT shifts the DIN bits; the model shifts zeros
RESET: the 50 us minimum pulse and the four-conversion wait after reset
DDC118: inputs on pins 14-17 and 20-23 (AIN8, AIN4, AIN7, AIN3, AIN6, AIN2, AIN5, AIN1)
variants: DDC112 (2 channels, DXMIT chip select), DDC114 (4 channels), DDC118 (8 channels) and DDC232 (32 channels, configuration register) are separate datasheets with the same retrieval scheme
